purpose: Resolve protocol interactions before attributing delimiter-scaling errors to source-ordinal mechanisms
square: PIL RGB BICUBIC 336x336, default Qwen processor as LAD
scores: Generated answer accuracy is primary; first-step format-conditioned candidate scores diagnostic only
attention: Reconstructed final-query attention; top2 visual-mass layers from 21..35 (3B), 16..27 (7B), save per-layer inclusive image mass; not a new AGD calibration
frozen_analysis: Full 2 model x 2 preprocessing x 2 prompt x 2 intervention cross; 4 rotations for each of 8 reused questions. Report all cells and within-question paired deltas. No SOTA/independent-test claim.
decision: If intervention direction depends on prompt/resolution/model, reject a universal ordinal-collapse explanation and isolate the responsible factor before designing a method.
